hook: A 1900 house remodelled 2015–2020 with a new foundation and reconfigured upper floors.

historic_district.name: Hartford Street Historic District
historic_district.significance_note: Significant under Criterion 3 for its association with master builder Fernando Nelson, as an early 20th-century Victorian-era residential tract development.

historic_survey.note: Listed among the houses Fernando Nelson built in Eureka Valley. The statement is reconnaissance-level and says inclusion in it is not a judgement on a building's worthiness for preservation. It records the row as single-storey end-gable dwellings with entry porch and bay window, and names Nelson's Hartford Street houses as a concentration of developer housing worth studying as a potential historic district. The recommendations print the range as 2-64 Hartford; the builder table prints it as 20-64.
